theme: canary severity gate COUNTFILELINE GREPFILE SETMATCHFILE threshold

tests.name: gate_under_over
tests.cmd: gate max=5 ok; max=1 over soft+REQUIRE exit2

tests.name: empty_polarity
tests.cmd: COUNT empty→0; GREPFILE empty→all lines; SETMATCH empty→none

weaknesses.title: Empty needle polarity split across single-file ops
weaknesses.detail: COUNTFILELINE "" → 0; GREPFILE "" → all lines (N=TOTAL); SETMATCHFILE "" → N=0 I=-1 no write; FINDFILELINE "" → first line. Same empty input, four behaviors. Agents cannot share one blank-needle policy.

weaknesses.title: GREP vs GREPFILE vs GREPLINES vs GREPFILES matrix
weaknesses.detail: String GREP, single-file GREPFILE, path-bag GREPLINES, path-list GREPFILES. Wrong op returns empty or wrong shape silently in soft mode.

weaknesses.title: SETMATCHFILE only first match; replacement may still match needle
weaknesses.detail: status=old→status=new then SETMATCHFILEI status= hits same line again (status=done) not STATUS=keep. Flip-all and skip-already-patched not supported.
weaknesses.repro: two status lines; patch twice stays on first

weaknesses.title: Substring false friends ERR⊂ERROR inflate gate counts
weaknesses.detail: Canary gate on ERR counts ERROR lines too. No whole-word mode on COUNTFILELINE/GREPFILE.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON extract bag glues without NL
weaknesses.detail: error: aerror: b — recurring bag collapse.

weaknesses.title: SETMATCHFILE rewrite may drop trailing NL on last file line
weaknesses.detail: cat -A canary after patch shows last line without final $.

weaknesses.title: No SETMATCHFILEALL / replace-all matching lines
weaknesses.detail: Only first match. Multi-row status flips need loop + FINDFILELINE I progression or REPLACEFILES whole-file.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently disables hard gate
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_SG_REQUIRE=abc leaves REQUIRE_HIT=0; gate over soft-succeeds.
